title: Chef John's Romesco Sauce
description: Chef John's romesco sauce recipe blends red peppers, garlic, sherry vinegar, roasted almonds, paprika, and cayenne into this versatile Spanish sauce.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon kosher salt, or more to taste

steps.text: Turn gas stove on; place bell pepper on burner. Char over flame, turning with tongs, until soft and blackened, about 5 minutes per side. Pepper should emit steam when pressed. Transfer pepper to a bowl, cover, and let cool to room temperature. Repeat with remaining peppers.

Heat oil and garlic in a skillet over medium heat; cook, stirring constantly, until garlic just starts to turn golden brown, about 3 minutes. Transfer garlic to a dish using a slotted spoon, leaving oil in the skillet.
Add bread cubes to the skillet; toast until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes.

Peel peppers under running water; remove and discard skins and seeds. Chop peppers; transfer to the bowl of a food processor. Add garlic, bread cubes with oil, almonds, vinegar, paprika, cayenne, and salt; pulse until sauce is well combined and reaches desired consistency.
Transfer sauce to a bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate to intensify the flavors, 8 hours to overnight.

video.description: One of the all-time greatest summer sauces, this classic Romesco is perfect with anything off the grill, especially vegetables and seafood. It also makes for an unbelievable sandwich spread, as well as a perfect secret ingredient for pasta dressings.
